scope: Historical pre-fix integrated image plus memory/inference profile; not a benchmark of the patched public PR heads.
notes: Measurements predate the AttnRes normalization and Unicode streaming fixes; they establish neither post-fix performance nor the earlier build task quality.
OFF and ON differ in source/image and memory/inference profile. This is not a same-image switch or isolated-kernel comparison.
Output throughput is total formal output tokens divided by the complete formal wall, including drain.
p95 TTFT is the original run-summary value, not a recomputed linearly interpolated quantile.
Every formal request reached its 300-token length cap. These are not naturally completed answer or task-quality results.
The original 120-second after-peer metadata deadline was missed. A later metadata-only continuation closed checks with zero generation POSTs; the original strict comparator remains failed.
Configured capture buckets, warmup routing and expert launch policy changed during public extraction. Current public source, capacity and performance need fresh GPU qualification.
A single paired run provides no confidence interval or run-to-run variance estimate.
